18E7.name: Yoshi has stomp ability
desc: Non-zero while the Yoshi Mario rides can stomp the ground (the colored-shell power: the stomp effect Yoshi gets from a
blue shell). Set from bit 0 of A in the Yoshi tongue/spit logic, cleared by the Yoshi sprite main routine, and read
by Mario's block and slope collision code.
Values: 0 = no stomp ability, 1 = has stomp ability.

18E8.name: Yoshi growing/swallow timer
desc: Countdown that, while non-zero, freezes the other sprites and counts down once per frame in the Yoshi sprite main routine
(it is copied into the sprites-locked flag and $13FB). Set to $40 when baby Yoshi swallows a caught sprite or is
stunned/carried; probably the growing/eating pause. Also tested by the item-spawn and Baby Yoshi helper code so they
skip work while it runs.
Values: 0 = not running.

18E9.name: Torpedo Ted puff slot
desc: Rotating index into the 4 minor extended sprite slots. When all four slots are busy, the Torpedo Ted trail puff spawner
decrements it (wrapping to 3) and overwrites that slot instead of failing.

18EA.name: Minor extended sprite X high
18EA.kind: byte table, one per minor extended sprite slot (index X or Y)
desc: High byte of the X position of minor extended sprites (water splashes, smoke puffs, Boo stream, shattered block pieces,
bounce sprites). The low byte is in a neighbouring table. Spawners store the parent sprite's or Mario's X high byte
(plus carry when the low byte is offset); the movers add a sign extension to it when X speed is applied.

18F7.name: Score sprite slot
desc: Rotating index of the next score sprite slot to use. The score spawner decrements it, wraps it back to 5 and uses it
as Y, so the oldest score sprite is replaced when all slots are full.

18F8.name: Block-hit hitbox timer
18F8.kind: byte table, indexed by hitbox slot (X or Y)
desc: Frames remaining for a block-hit hitbox (bounce block or cape hit sprite). Set to 6 when the slot is claimed;
decremented each frame by the bounce block and cape hit routine.

18FC.name: Piranha plant slot index
desc: Rotating index (0-7) used by the Piranha plant routine to pick a slot; decremented and wrapped back to 7.

18FE.name: Diagonal Bullet Bill timer
desc: Frame counter for the surrounding/diagonal Bullet Bill generator. Incremented each time the generator runs and reset
to 0 when it reaches its limit (comment in the source says $A0).

18FF.name: Shooter slot index
desc: Rotating index used when loading a level shooter sprite into the shooter tables; decremented and wrapped back to 7.

1900.name: Bonus star counter / score value
desc: Course clear bonus stars remaining, in BCD. The course clear routine tests it for zero and counts it down while
tallying the bonus, one point of score per step. Also written by the 'set score value from height' routine (bank 07),
which stores a value here for the score handling to read.

1901.name: Bounce sprite OAM property
1901.kind: byte table, indexed by bounce sprite slot
desc: YXPPCCCT property byte for a bounce sprite's tile. Stored when the bounce sprite is set up and ORed with $64 (priority)
when the bounce sprite is drawn into OAM.

1906.name: Iggy/Larry platform hold timer
desc: Frames the tilting platform in Iggy/Larry's room stays stationary at maximum tilt. While non-zero it counts down and
the platform does not move; when it reaches zero the next phase ($1907) starts.

1907.name: Iggy/Larry platform phase
desc: Current phase of the tilting platform in Iggy/Larry's room. Incremented when a tilt finishes and wrapped to 0 after 5.
Values: 0-5 select the direction/rate steps in the tilt sequence.

1909.name: Creating/eating block frozen flag
desc: Set to $FF when the creating/eating block sprite is initialised; cleared by Mario's block collision code. The block
main routine tests it for $FF (probably 'block is frozen/not yet touched').
Values: $FF = set at init, 0 = cleared.

190A.name: Fading Boo timer
desc: Fade timer for the cluster Boos (ghosts that fade in and out); counts down toward 0 and is read by the cluster sprite
routine (value is copied to $185E). Cleared when cluster type 5 is spawned.

190B.name: Boo fade level
desc: Fade step 0-8 used for the palette transparency effect on fading Boos. Set by the cluster sprite routine; incremented
by the Big Boo boss states and read to choose the palette entry.

190C.name: Directional coin timer
desc: Frame timer started by a directional coin block. While running it counts down in the Directional Coins sprite.
Also ORed with the P-switch timers when the level-start setup and Mario OAM code decide palette/blue-POW handling.
Cleared by the spawn sprite from block routine.

190D.name: Bowser Peach-appears flag
desc: Incremented in Bowser's phase 9 (bounce on the floor); probably flags the Peach-appears event. Read by the Bowser scene
item box and floor/roof drawing and by the Bowser room palette/lightning flash code, which change behaviour once set.

190E.name: Sprite buoyancy setting
desc: Level header sprite buoyancy bits: the first byte of the level's sprite data AND $C0, stored at level load. Non-zero
makes sprites float/swim; tested by sprite-block interaction, Cheep Cheep and orange platform init.
Bits: 7-6 = buoyancy setting from the sprite header.

190F.name: Sprite tweaker byte 190F
190F.kind: byte table, indexed by sprite slot
desc: Per-sprite property bits copied from Sprite190FVals when the sprite is spawned. Read by block interaction, Mario-sprite
contact (stomp/kick/hurt), draw and off-screen checks, Yoshi swallow, fireball hits and level end processing.
Bit 7 is cleared when a sprite is erased.

191C.name: Yoshi tongue holds key flag
desc: Incremented in the Yoshi tongue logic when the sprite on the tongue is number $80 (a key); tested by the keyhole
sprite when Mario is on Yoshi. Cleared by the spawn-item-from-sprite routine (probably when the key is gone).

191D.name: Sumo Bro flame slot index
desc: Rotating index (0-9) into the extended sprite table used when spawning a Sumo Bro flame; decremented and wrapped to 9
when all slots are busy.

1921.name: Ending picture step
desc: Step number of the Peach ending picture sequence (state 5). Incremented each time the step timer in $1540 expires and
used as an index into the timing table; the sequence ends at $54. Also read when drawing the Peach message letters.

1925.name: Level mode
desc: Level data format/mode: header bits (byte 2 AND $1F) selecting how objects, layers and Map16 are loaded for this level.
Set to 7 for the overworld map and 0 on the level names/OW border setup. Used by the level object loader and layer
pointer tables, the Map16 generator and layer 2 updates.

1928.name: Screen counter / scene phase
desc: In level load: the current screen number, reset to 0 and incremented when an object starts a new page ($0A bit 7).
In credits: scene phase/timer (set to $E2 at actor init) used by the background DMA and screen wipe. Mario
animation B sets it to 7 for the message box freeze.

192A.name: Level entrance type
desc: Written to 0 or from other level-load data in the level pointer setup (probably the level entrance type from the
header); read by the Mario Start! level setup.

192B.name: Sprite graphics set
desc: Sprite GFX set number for the level (level header byte 3 AND $0F). Set to fixed values for cutscenes ($14) and the
overworld ($11). Read by the GFX upload routine and by some sprite graphics.

192D.name: Foreground palette setting
desc: Foreground color palette set for the level (level header byte 4 AND 7); fixed values for overworld and cutscenes.
Read by the level palette loader.

192E.name: Sprite palette setting
desc: Sprite palette set for the level ((header byte 4 AND $38) >> 3); 0 or 2 for title/cutscene/overworld. Read by the
level palette loader.

192F.name: Background color setting
desc: Level background color setting (level header byte 2 >> 5); 3 in cutscenes. Read by the level palette loader.

1930.name: Background palette setting
desc: Level background palette set (level header byte 1 >> 5); 3 in cutscenes. Read by the level palette loader.

1931.name: Tileset
desc: Tileset number of the current level (from the level header; $18 for the cutscene castle, $FF at Mario Start, a fixed
value per overworld submap). Indexes block interaction, Map16 pointers, palettes, layer 3 and sprite GFX uploads.
Its partner $1932 is reset together with it.

1933.name: Current layer
desc: Which layer is being processed: 0 = layer 1, 1 = layer 2. The level loader increments it to move to layer 2;
block collision, block spawning and sprite routines set it from the layer they hit and later read it.
Values: 0 = layer 1, 1 = layer 2.

1935.name: Extra Mario tile upload flag
desc: Set to 1 when Mario's extra tile rows at $0BF6 are queued for DMA to VRAM; the Mario graphics DMA routine tests it
and clears it after uploading.
Values: 0 = nothing pending, 1 = upload pending.

1938.name: Level sprite load status
1938.kind: byte table, indexed by level sprite entry
desc: Per level-data sprite entry: whether it has been spawned. Set (incremented) when the entry is loaded so it is not
spawned twice; cleared when the sprite is erased off-screen so it can respawn when scrolled back.
Values: 0 = not loaded, non-zero = loaded.

19B8.name: Screen exit table
desc: Destination level number for each screen exit of the level. Filled by the level exit objects and read by the level
loader to find the target level.

1B78.name: On hardcoded OW path flag
desc: Overworld flag: cleared when Mario starts walking from a level tile or when he arrives, meaning he is not on a
hardcoded path.
Values: 0 = not on a hardcoded path.

1B7A.name: Overworld path step
desc: Current step along the hardcoded overworld path; cleared when walking from a level tile and set to the step index
while Mario walks.

1B80.name: Overworld walk speed set
desc: Index selecting the overworld walk speed table (1 on tiles with property $14, otherwise 0); read when Mario walks.

1B82.name: Overworld event X position
desc: X position of the overworld event effect (low nibble of map position * 16); used to place the smoke puff.

1B83.name: Overworld event Y position
desc: Y position of the overworld event effect; used with $1B82 to place the smoke puff.

1B84.name: Overworld event timer
desc: Smoke puff timer for the overworld event, set to $28 when it starts and counted down; also used as a tile source
index when applying edits.

1B86.name: Overworld event state
desc: State of the overworld event machine (tile changes, smoke puff, fading tiles). Advanced with INC after each stage
and cleared when the event is applied to the layer 1 map.

1B87.name: Overworld sub-state
desc: Shared overworld state counter: lives exchange iris state, save prompt/message box state and the game over message
(incremented on negative lives). Set to 1 to start the player switch and 5 after the level (probably the save prompt).

1B88.name: Box/iris direction
desc: Direction/state for the overworld message box (0 = opening/open, 1 = closing), the lives exchange iris and the
credits screen wipe (1 = grow toward $E0, 0 = shrink to 0).
Values: 0 = opening or shrinking, 1 = closing or growing.
